title: A workflow may not key its concurrency group on a bare ref — a queued run that never executed can otherwise be cancelled into a permanently dead required check, leaving the PR unmergeable with no code failure

A business date (YYYY-MM-DD) must never be pinned to UTC for display — it has no timezone, and new Date(iso+"T00:00:00Z") renders one day early for every viewer west of UTC, which silently showed the wrong day cash position in Central Time
